steps.en: Alternative address becomes the address the reminder is sent to
steps.id: Alamat alternatif jadi alamat tujuan reminder
steps.why_en: Only happens as a side effect of revival; no resend action, address is typed by hand.
steps.why_id: Hanya terjadi sebagai efek samping revival; tidak ada aksi resend, alamat diketik manual.

steps.en: Notice returns to the reminder queue once unsuspended
steps.id: Notice kembali ke antrian reminder setelah suspension dicabut
steps.why_en: Notice resumes its old schedule; nothing resets it to resend a past reminder.
steps.why_id: Notice lanjut ke jadwal lama; tidak ada reset untuk mengirim ulang reminder yang lewat.

steps.en: Print run picks the notice and uses the alternative address
steps.id: Run cetak memilih notice dan memakai alamat alternatif
steps.why_en: Selection is right, but the letter run only starts when someone triggers it by hand.
steps.why_id: Pemilihan sudah benar, tapi run surat baru jalan kalau dipicu manual.

steps.en: Letter files are produced and sent to the print vendor
steps.id: File surat dibuat dan dikirim ke vendor cetak
steps.why_en: Sending to the print vendor is switched off in the production settings.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman ke vendor cetak dimatikan di pengaturan produksi.
